title: Revit Project Template Change, Release and Retirement
trigger: A governed Revit project template requires creation, modification, release, replacement, or retirement.

steps.action: Record the proposed template change with rationale, affected template scope, intended impact, and supporting evidence.
inputs: affected template identity or intended scope

steps.action: Prepare the candidate template in a controlled non-production context and update its governed content manifest for the proposed release.

Validate the candidate template against the applicable governed standards, content manifest, and conformance tests; record missing content, regressions, compatibility impacts, and unresolved exceptions.
inputs: applicable governed Revit standards and registries

steps.action: Route the validated candidate to the applicable standards-governance authority for release authorization. This workflow does not assign or infer the approving role.
outputs: release authorization, rejection, or required remediation

steps.action: For an authorized release, assign the governed template release identifier, publish the approved template and manifest to the controlled source, and issue release notes including material changes, compatibility or migration impacts, and known limitations.

Communicate adoption of the new release and mark superseded releases as deprecated or retired according to the applicable retention or sunset policy, without deleting traceability to prior project baselines.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable Appendix E proposal-to-adoption lifecycle while leaving approver identities, repository paths, release values, communication channels, and sunset periods unresolved until governed elsewhere.
